Behavior & Comms Score 3.0: Definitive Overhaul Blueprint
21 Oct @ 1:10am
Azure
Originally posted by sky3tone:
Originally posted by Azure:
The current Behavior Score system often punishes innocent players while letting actual griefers slide. Here is a comprehensive blueprint to completely rework the system and make matchmaking fair again

If anyone at VALVE is reading this to rework the behavior score algorithm — you need to integrate a baseline text-verification filter and automated audio transcription before letting raw report volume tank a user's score.
For support roles, this shield must also trigger based on high healing, camps stacked, or high warding impact. A player must not be punished for an unusual item build or a non-meta pick if their performance metrics prove they were actively fighting and creating space

Exception: This performance shield only drops if Overwatch manually reviews the case and proves the player was actively ignoring the main objectives or throwing the game despite having good individual stats

Furthermore, if game telemetry detects absolutely no signs of abandoning, intentional feeding, griefing, or AFK behavior, the player must receive a guaranteed, flat increase to their behavior score after the match.
